before.requirement: An object-member type mismatch reports the expected and actual types without naming the member.
before.reason: The key-qualified diagnostic did not exist on this side.

after.requirement: An object-member type mismatch can report the expected and actual types together with the member key.
after.reason: The object unpacker passes the member key to the type validator, which uses it in the error text. The harness calls json_unpack, whose wrapper passes a null error pointer, and its fixed formats also avoid typed member validation.

claims.reason: The same harness has no route to the diagnostic added after the change; the before contract had no corresponding key-qualified output.

before.requirement: Unpack scalar values with type-specific format characters and reject mismatched JSON types.
before.reason: The source supports s, i, I, b, f, F and n; the harness selects none of them.

after.requirement: Unpack scalar values with type-specific format characters and reject mismatched JSON types.
after.reason: The typed format cases remain supported, and the harness still selects only o.

claims.reason: The same fixed o format strings prevent typed scalar unpacking on both sides.

before.requirement: A required object member absent from the JSON object produces the item-not-found result.
before.reason: The harness uses {s?o}, so absence of data takes the optional path.

after.requirement: A required object member absent from the JSON object produces the item-not-found result.
after.reason: Required lookup remains supported, but the harness still uses the optional form.

claims.reason: The optional marker in the same fixed object format prevents the required-member condition on both sides.

before.requirement: A strict object unpack rejects JSON members left unaccessed by the format.
before.reason: The object format contains no strict marker, and json_unpack supplies flags zero.

after.requirement: A strict object unpack rejects JSON members left unaccessed by the format.
after.reason: The strict check remains, while the harness's object format and flags are unchanged.

claims.reason: The fixed object format lacks ! and the call supplies zero flags on both sides. The array format's ! does not make object strictness reachable.

before.requirement: An array format requesting an absent element produces an index-out-of-range result.
before.reason: The array call is skipped for size zero and its single o token requests only index zero.

after.requirement: An array format requesting an absent element produces an index-out-of-range result.
after.reason: The result remains supported; the harness still skips empty arrays and requests just index zero.

claims.reason: The size guard and one-element format are the same concrete constraint on both sides.

before.requirement: Unpacking with O increments the extracted value's reference count.
before.reason: No harness unpack format contains O.

after.requirement: Unpacking with O increments the extracted value's reference count.
after.reason: The O behavior remains supported and absent from the harness's formats.

claims.reason: The same fixed o formats omit the distinct O ownership mode on both sides.

before.requirement: An object or array unpack format rejects a nonmatching, nonnull root type.
before.reason: The harness guards its object and array format calls with matching type checks.

after.requirement: An object or array unpack format rejects a nonmatching, nonnull root type.
after.reason: The rejection remains supported, and the harness still guards both calls with matching type checks.

claims.reason: The same type guards prevent either container mismatch on both sides.
